why: The answer depends on the thermal stability of group 1 and group 2 carbonates - MgCO3 decomposes most easily because the small, highly polarising Mg2+ destabilises the carbonate ion - and no chapter in the supplied list teaches that.
note: Expected chapter: 'The s-Block Elements' (alkali and alkaline earth metals; thermal stability of carbonates), which is absent from the supplied list. Nearest available homes are 'Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties' (it carries an 'S-Block and Its Characteristics' topic) and 'Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure' (polarising power / Fajans' rules), but neither actually teaches carbonate decomposition, so filing it there would hide the gap.
